role: XCUITest coverage of Settings → Advanced Data Controls → Delete All My Data: the destructive button is disabled until the typed phrase, warning copy exists, and backing out does not purge.

flags.text: Passes the bare '-UITests' launch argument, which no production code reads (only -UITests-FreshInstall at AppLaunchRecovery.swift:185 and -UITests-ForcePaywall/-UITests-SeedArchive at UITestLaunchArguments.swift:18,23 are checked); it is inert
Class doc says the success summary surfacing every category is asserted and that XCTSkipUnless guards the destructive button; neither exists in the tests (no purge is run, no skip on the button)

Doc cites widget data purge as the reason this surface is critical and says the explanatory copy lists the widget purge; the app has no widget (DataPurgeService.swift:647-649 only erases legacy keys) and no test checks for it

units.does: Sets continueAfterFailure=false, creates XCUIApplication, appends launch arguments -UITests, -UITests-FreshInstall and English locale (UITestLanguage.english), launches the app (the app wipes onboarding/disclaimer/paywall flags, settings files and the session archive via AppLaunchRecovery.resetUITestStateIfRequested) and walks every first-run gate with UITestLaunch.toMainUI, ignoring its Bool result.
units.entry: XCTest runner: setUp before each test in the class

units.does: Releases the XCUIApplication (app = nil); does not terminate the app.
units.entry: XCTest runner: tearDown after each test in the class

units.does: Opens Settings via More, scrolls to settings.advancedDataControls and taps it, then asserts settings.deleteAllData row exists and taps it.

On the Delete-All-Data page: swipes up to 8 times to find deleteAllData.confirmButton, asserts it exists and is disabled, swipes to find deleteAllData.confirmField and asserts it exists, and asserts warning copy containing irreversible/permanent/cannot be undone/remove.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.cond: confirm button not yet in tree (<=8 swipes)
confirm field not yet in tree (<=8 swipes)

flags.text: Never types the phrase, so it does not prove the button enables with the correct phrase (or stays disabled with a wrong one); the 'remove' predicate matches nearly any explanatory copy

units.does: Opens Delete-All-Data, taps the first navigation-bar button (skips if none), asserts the delete row is shown again, backgrounds and re-activates the app so the disclaimer acceptance setUp wrote is flushed (backgroundToPersist), then terminates, relaunches with only -UITests (no fresh install) and asserts the health disclaimer does not appear within 10s (evidence the purge did not run).
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

flags.text: navigationBars.buttons.first is assumed to be Back; any leading bar button would be tapped instead

The 'returned to Advanced Data Controls' check uses UITestFind.row, whose label fallback (buttons CONTAINS[c] 'Delete All My Data') also matches the Delete page's own destructive button (label at DeleteAllDataPage.swift:144); when that button is in the accessibility tree the assertion passes even if the back tap did nothing
